title: 第二十五章贼心不死张家第二十六章老六李长寿大举进攻张家
slug: 多子多福照顾女帝一天修为涨一万
lines: 苏千凡听到张家顺藤摸瓜想要暗杀她，攥紧粉拳，绝美的脸颊上闪过无尽杀意。
“这是张家的令牌，绝对没有错，我不会忘记的。”
经过夫君的照料，她已经突破到金丹初期，想要灭了张家为族人报仇，实力还是不够。
“好一个张家，还真是贼心不死。”
“老朽本想日后等千凡成长起来让她亲自报仇，现在看来是时候送他们下地狱了。”
李长寿将灵茶一饮而尽，起身来到苏千凡前，拉住了她的小手。
“千凡放心，咱们这就去大荒，为父给你报仇！”
“报仇！”苏千凡的眼眶红润，将头埋在李长寿的怀里。
他就像是一座连绵不绝的大山，每次当她无助遇到危险时，都会站在她的身边，挡在她的身前。
这一刻，她真的泪目了。
“这么说，前辈是打算去大荒了？”
“区区一个张家罢了，老朽只需要略微发力即可。”
声音落下，阴影中走出四名身穿黑袍脸戴面具之人。
王麻子...血云子...丧彪…王德发等…四人全都是李长寿用太极魔身马甲所化。
自从他突破到元婴巅峰，这是李长寿所能分化的最大限度，四道魔身，全都是元婴后期修为。
其实力早已远超一般的中型家族，完全是死侍级别。
“主人！”四人全都对着李长寿恭敬行礼。
正在喝茶的叶英俊忍不住倒吸了口凉气，根本没有发现这间小院中隐藏着四名强者。
‘我堂堂化神期后期，竟然没有丝毫察觉，只怕这些侍卫的修为全在我之上。’
‘看来小姐让我保护李前辈，纯属多余了，得把这件事告诉小姐。’
‘不行，万一告诉了小姐，家族要是把我召回怎么办，还是先拖一拖吧！’
“大荒张家胆敢动我的人，老朽不希望他们活在这个世上。”
“去把张家家主和长老各位长老的首级拿过来，懂？”
李长寿话音低沉，犹如一个深渊中的王者，在下达这蕴含天意的圣旨。
“主人放心，我们这就去灭了张家，讨回一个公道。”
说完，四道身影再次融入到阴影，消失在原地。
“前辈，我突然想起来炉子上还烤着灵鸡，就先失陪了。”此时此刻，叶英俊的茶杯都在发抖，不对...是他的手在发抖。
李长寿至少是渡劫期的大能，他是怎么敢怎么做到在这心安理得喝茶。
自己什么实力总得有点b数吧！
随便找了一个借口，叶英俊火速开溜。
等到他离开后，楚玉璃和苏千凡才敢问出心里的疑问。
“夫君，您的这些人和太强了，到底是什么境界，又是什么时候来到李府的。”
“早在我入驻黑风城，他们便一直都在了。”李长寿淡淡一笑，“至于是什么境界，遇强则强，足以守护咱们这片小家，保护好你们的安全。”
不管什么时候，哪怕是面对夫人，这种b还是要装的。
总是给他们一种高人形象，让其感到深不可测。
尤其是叶英俊那边，经过这件事，就算叶家注意到他，也不敢轻举妄动。
两位夫人闻言，也安心了不少。
至少在她们眼中，夫君是无所不能的。
“夫君，你都炼了好几个月的丹，是不是已经把我们给忘了。”
content_en:
When Su Qianfan heard that the Zhang family was trying to assassinate her, she clenched her pink fists, and endless murderous intent flashed across her beautiful cheeks.
"This is the Zhang family's token. There is absolutely nothing wrong with it. I will not forget it."
After her husband's care, she has broken through to the early stage of the Golden Elixir. She wants to destroy the Zhang family and avenge her people, but she is still not strong enough.
"What a Zhang family, they are really evil-minded."
"I originally wanted to wait for Qianfan to grow up and let her take revenge in person in the future, but now it seems it is time to send them to hell."
Li Changshou drank the spiritual tea in one gulp, stood up, came to Su Qianfan, and held her little hand.
"Don't worry Qianfan, let's go to the wilderness right now to avenge your father!"
"Revenge!" Su Qianfan's eyes were red and he buried his head in Li Changshou's arms.
He was like an endless mountain. Every time she was helpless and in danger, he would stand by her side and block in front of her.
At this moment, she really burst into tears.
"So, senior is planning to go to the wilderness?"
"It's just a Zhang family, the old man only needs a little effort."
The voice fell, and four people wearing black robes and masks walked out of the shadows.
Wang Mazi... Xueyunzi... Sangbiao... Wang Defa, etc... all four of them were transformed by Li Changshou using the Tai Chi Demon Body Vest.
Since he broke through to the peak of Yuanying, this is the maximum level that Li Changshou can differentiate. The four demon bodies are all at the later stage of Yuanying.
Its strength has far exceeded that of ordinary medium-sized families, and is completely at the level of Deadpool.
"Master!" All four of them saluted Li Changshou respectfully.
"Hiss..."
Ye Yingjun, who was drinking tea, couldn't help but take a breath of cold air. He didn't realize that there were four strong men hidden in this small courtyard.
‘I am in the late stage of my divine transformation, but I didn’t realize it at all. I was afraid that the cultivation level of these guards were all superior to mine. ’
‘It seems that it is unnecessary for the lady to ask me to protect Senior Li. I have to tell the lady about this. ’
‘No, if I tell the lady, what if the family calls me back? I’d better delay it for a while! ’
"The Dahuang Zhang family dares to touch my people, I don't want them to live in this world."
"Go and get the heads of the head of the Zhang family and the elders, do you understand?"
Li Changshou spoke in a low voice, like a king in the abyss, issuing an imperial edict that contained God's will.
"Don't worry, Master, we will destroy the Zhang family and seek justice."
After saying that, the four figures merged into the shadows again and disappeared.
"Senior, I suddenly remembered that there was a spiritual chicken roasting on the stove, so I'll excuse you." At this moment, Ye Yingjun's teacup was trembling, no... it was his hands that were trembling.
Li Changshou is at least a powerful person in the tribulation period. How dare he drink tea here with peace of mind.
No matter what your strength, you must have some B-numbers!
Making a random excuse, Ye Yingjun left quickly.
After he left, Chu Yuli and Su Qianfan dared to ask the questions in their hearts.
"Husband, these people of yours are too strong. What state are they in, and when did they come to the Li Mansion?"
"They have been here since I settled in Black Wind City." Li Changshou smiled faintly, "As for what state they are in, they become stronger when they encounter strong ones. They are enough to protect our little family and protect your safety."
No matter when, even if you are facing your wife, you still have to pretend like this.
Always give them a superior image, making them feel unfathomable.
Especially for Ye Yingjun, after this incident, even if the Ye family noticed him, they would not dare to act rashly.
The two ladies felt a lot more relieved after hearing this.
At least in their eyes, their husbands are omnipotent.
"Husband, you have been practicing elixirs for several months, have you forgotten about us?"
title_en: Chapter 25: The evil-minded Zhang Family Chapter 26: Li Changshou, the sixth brother, attacks the Zhang Family on a large scale
